pressure.label: Pressure — Commercial Fishing
pressure.description: VMS (Vessel Monitoring System — satellite tracking of commercial fishing vessels) density 2015–2019 (Northeast Ocean Data), mean density class per cell. ↗ · ↗

resource.label: Resource — Nursery Areas
resource.description: NC Fishery Nursery Areas designation (NC Division of Marine Fisheries), % cell area covered. ↗ · ↗

Fishing x Nursery Areas.interpretation: only a few cells combine high activity with nursery coverage — the closure system is largely working. Watch the band of activity pressed against nursery boundaries.

Vessel Count x Submerged Aquatic Vegetat.servicePair: Vessel Count x Submerged Aquatic Vegetation

pressure.label: Pressure — Vessel Count
pressure.description: AIS (Automatic Identification System — transponder tracking of vessels) transit counts 2025 (Northeast Ocean Data Portal), summed per cell. ↗ · ↗

resource.label: Resource — Submerged Aquatic Vegetation (SAV)
resource.description: SAV (submerged aquatic vegetation — underwater grass beds) mapping 2019–2020 (NC Dept. of Environmental Quality), % cell area covered. ↗ · ↗

Vessel Count x Submerged Aquatic Vegetat.interpretation: the darkest cells mark shipping lanes and ferry corridors crossing SAV beds — priority zones for speed restrictions, signage, or channel review.

pressure.label: Pressure — Community Vulnerability
pressure.description: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index (SVI) 2022, mean percentile per cell — the demand side. ↗ · ↗

resource.label: Resource — Tourism
resource.description: NC beach and waterfront public access points, count per cell — the supply side. ↗ · ↗

Community Vulnerability x Tourism.interpretation: the darkest cells are vulnerable communities with heavy tourist access — congestion and displacement hotspots. High vulnerability with few access points marks the resident-access gap.

pressure.label: Pressure — Shoreline Erosion
pressure.description: NC oceanfront erosion rates 2020 (NC Division of Coastal Management), eroding shoreline km per cell. ↗ · ↗

resource.label: Resource — Wetland Potential
resource.description: NOAA C-CAP (Coastal Change Analysis Program) wetland potential layer, land wetness likelihood 1–9 (open water excluded). ↗ · ↗

Shoreline Erosion x Wetland Potential.interpretation: the darkest cells are eroding shorefront backed by high wetland-migration potential — priority candidates for living shorelines and shoreline-hardening policy review.

pressure.label: Pressure — Salinity
pressure.description: Estuarine shoreline length per cell (NC DCM 2012), used as a proxy for the saltwater front. ↗ · ↗

resource.label: Resource — Agriculture
resource.description: NLCD (National Land Cover Database) 2025 cropland — pasture + cultivated crops, % cell area. ↗ · ↗

Salinity x Agriculture.interpretation: the darkest cells are the salt front pressing against farmland — where intrusion risk to agriculture is highest.

Sea Level Rise x Ferry Route.servicePair: Sea Level Rise x Ferry Route

pressure.label: Pressure — Sea Level Rise
pressure.description: NOAA sea level rise inundation footprint (Northern + Middle 2 NC), % cell area covered. ↗ · ↗

resource.label: Resource — Ferry Route
resource.description: U.S. DOT ferry routes + terminals, route length (km) and terminal count per cell. ↗ · ↗

Sea Level Rise x Ferry Route.interpretation: the darkest cells mark ferry corridors crossing inundation footprints — priorities for terminal elevation, docking retrofit, and service contingency planning.

pressure.label: Pressure — Community Vulnerability
pressure.description: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index (SVI) 2022 — higher score means a more vulnerable community; mean percentile per cell. ↗ · ↗

resource.label: Resource — Conservation
resource.description: PAD-US (Protected Areas Database of the U.S.) 4.1 protected lands (GAP 1–3), % cell area covered. ↗ · ↗

Community Vulnerability x Conservation.interpretation: the darkest cells are protected lands overlapping high-vulnerability communities — the engagement priority list for access agreements, stewardship, and Tribal / local consultation.
